name: Vonage Home Phone
notes: Researched from public support.vonage.com residential articles only (no sign-in). Vonage bills one month in advance and charges the payment method on file automatically on the same day each month (the sign-up day; days 29-31 shift to the 28th in short months), so there is no optional AutoPay to enroll in or cancel, and service is paperless only (statements are viewed, downloaded as PDF or printed in the Online Account). Payments in the Online Account use Pay Now under Account Status (past-due balance, one-time or early payment; early payments are capped at $400 and need a credit or debit card - the engine cannot cap early payments). The payment method is changed in Billing and Payment > Update Payment Method. Bank bill pay is not accepted. Without signing in, customers pay through the Automated Payment Hotline (1-800-528-7690, card and Security PIN) or MoneyGram (Receive Code 15059, $1.49 MoneyGram fee). Usage beyond plan charges over $75 can trigger mid-cycle billing. Cancellation can be requested online (Cancel Account Request) or by calling 1-732-944-0000. Payment arrangements are not described (family default kept); plan prices not modelled. The sign-in identifier is not described on the pages used. Reviewer: Vonage pages only mention credit and debit cards for online payments and the payment method on file, so billing.methods is card-only.

guest_pay.note: There is no online payment without signing in. Call the Automated Payment Hotline at 1-800-528-7690 or pay at a MoneyGram location with Receive Code 15059 ($1.49 MoneyGram fee).

autopay.note: Vonage always charges the payment method on file automatically each billing date; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic charges cannot be turned off; update the payment method in Billing and Payment, or cancel the account.

paperless.note: Vonage is paperless only; paper bills are not available. View, download or print statements in the Online Account.

cancel_service.note: Use Cancel Account Request in the Online Account, or call 1-732-944-0000.

pay_by_mail.note: Vonage lists online, the automated hotline and MoneyGram as ways to pay; no mailing address for payments is given and bank bill pay is not accepted.

help.title: How Vonage billing works
paragraphs: Your billing cycle starts on the day you sign up and you are billed one month in advance. Vonage charges your payment method automatically on about the same day each month; if you signed up on the 29th, 30th or 31st, shorter months bill on the 28th. After 45 days you may ask to change your billing date if you meet the conditions.
Vonage is paperless: view, download or print current and past statements in your Online Account. Payment confirmation emails are not sent unless you ask for them, and there are no payment reminders.
If charges outside your plan pass $75 during a cycle, you may be billed mid-cycle; that amount is credited toward your next bill. Paying through your bank's bill pay is not supported.

help.title: Make a payment
paragraphs: Sign in to your Online Account and select Pay Now under Account Status to pay a past-due balance, make a one-time payment or pay early. Early payments are limited to $400 and must be made with a credit or debit card.

Without signing in, call the Automated Payment Hotline at 1-800-528-7690 (English only) to pay a past-due balance or update your card, or pay at any U.S. MoneyGram location with Receive Code 15059; MoneyGram charges a $1.49 fee.
If an automatic charge fails, your account becomes past due until you pay.

help.title: Update your payment information
paragraphs: In your Online Account open the Billing and Payment tab, choose Update Payment Method, enter the new details and select Save. You can also update a credit or debit card through the Automated Payment Hotline at 1-800-528-7690 with your Security PIN.

help.title: Cancel your Vonage account
paragraphs: Sign in to your Online Account, select Cancel Account Request, choose your reason and the date you want service disconnected, review and submit.
You can also call 1-732-944-0000, Monday to Friday 9 AM to midnight ET and weekends 9 AM to 8 PM ET. Spanish-speaking representatives are available Monday to Saturday until 8 PM ET.
steps: Sign in to your Online Account.
Choose a reason and a disconnect date.

extra.intent: Using Vonage's support pages, find the largest early payment you can make on a Vonage residential account. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Switch your Vonage account to receive paper bills by mail. If Vonage does not offer paper bills, do not change anything and say so.

solution.text: Vonage does not offer paper bills; statements are only available online.

extra.intent: You want to pay your Vonage bill in cash at MoneyGram. Find the MoneyGram Receive Code Vonage gives. Do not make a payment.
